title: Safety database update — September 25, 2026
summary: Major public safety databases remain available with no confirmed change affecting the freshness or availability of search results.
updates: FDA has scheduled updates to its separate electronic reporting submission system; this does not affect the public safety databases used for searching.
No significant access, search, or data-feed changes were confirmed for the other available databases.
no_major_changes: BfArM, Swissmedic, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada, ANVISA, PMDA, AEMPS, ANSM, NMPA, and FDA public safety searches continue without a confirmed source-platform change.
